title: SEBI Grade A (Assistant Manager)
kicker: Officer recruitment at the securities regulator

value.body: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) recruits Officers Grade A (Assistant Manager) to work on regulation, supervision, enforcement and investigations in India's securities markets. Recruitment is stream-wise — General, Legal, Information Technology, Research, Official Language and Engineering — and not every stream is advertised every year.

items.label: Vacancies, 2025 notification
items.note: 110 at first; raised by an addendum

items.label: Age limit
items.note: As on the cut-off date in the notification; relaxation for reserved categories

items.label: Stages
items.note: Phase I screening; Phase II includes descriptive English and a stream paper

value.title: How you get in
value.body: General: a master's degree in any discipline, or a bachelor's in law or engineering, or CA / CFA / CS / Cost Accountant. Legal: a bachelor's in law (with post-qualification experience as an advocate where the notification requires it). IT: an engineering degree, or a bachelor's plus a postgraduate qualification in computer science / IT / computer applications. Research: a master's in economics, statistics, finance, commerce or a related field. Selection is a two-phase online exam followed by an interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Seats are few — around one hundred or so in recent cycles — and spread across several streams.
Professional qualifications (CA, CS, CFA, law) open the General stream to non-postgraduates.
Notifications are not on a fixed calendar; some years have had no recruitment.
The syllabus overlaps with RBI Grade B and NABARD Grade A (economics, finance, management, English).
